entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after the day you arrive in Taiwan.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después del día de llegada a Taiwán.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive.

entry.en: You must complete a Taiwan Arrival Card online within three days before your arrival.
entry.es: Debes completar online la Tarjeta de Llegada de Taiwán dentro de los tres días previos a tu llegada.
entry.quote: You must complete a Taiwan Arrival Card (TWAC) within three days before your arrival in Taiwan.

entry.en: You can visit Taiwan without a visa for up to 90 days, extendable by a further 90 days once there.
entry.es: Puedes visitar Taiwán sin visado hasta 90 días, ampliables otros 90 una vez allí.
entry.quote: You can visit Taiwan without a visa for up to 90 days. You can extend this by a further 90 days once you have arrived in Taiwan.

entry.en: If you plan to stay longer than 180 days, you must have a visa before you arrive.
entry.es: Si planeas quedarte más de 180 días, debes tener un visado antes de llegar.
entry.quote: If you plan to stay in Taiwan for longer than 180 days, you must have a visa before you arrive.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth more than 100,000 NTD or 10,000 US dollars must be declared.
entry.es: Debes declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje que superen 100.000 NTD o 10.000 dólares estadounidenses.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is higher than 100,000 New Taiwan dollars (NTD) or 10,000 US dollars.

entry.en: Animal products must not be brought into Taiwan without authorisation, or you may face a heavy fine.
entry.es: No se deben traer productos animales a Taiwán sin autorización, o podrías recibir una multa elevada.
entry.quote: Do not bring animal products into Taiwan without authorisation. If you are caught with any animal products, you may face a heavy fine.

safety.en: Crime rates are extremely low in Taiwan, but travellers are advised to remain vigilant.
safety.es: Las tasas de delincuencia en Taiwán son extremadamente bajas, pero se aconseja mantenerse alerta.
safety.quote: Crime rates are extremely low in Taiwan. However, travellers are advised to remain vigilant

safety.en: The text says pickpockets are a known problem in crowded areas such as night markets, while violent crime and muggings are very rare.
safety.es: El texto indica que los carteristas son un problema conocido en zonas concurridas como mercados nocturnos, mientras que los delitos violentos y atracos son muy raros.
safety.quote: pickpockets are a known problem, but violent crime and muggings are very rare.

safety.en: Drug laws are stricter than in the UK, and convictions can bring a severe prison sentence or, in some cases, the death penalty.
safety.es: Las leyes sobre drogas son más estrictas que en el Reino Unido, y pueden acarrear penas de prisión severas o, en algunos casos, la pena de muerte.
safety.quote: you should expect to get a severe prison sentence or, in some cases, the death penalty.

safety.en: The typhoon season normally runs from May to November, with a risk of road blockages and landslides afterwards.
safety.es: La temporada de tifones suele ir de mayo a noviembre, con riesgo de cortes de carreteras y deslizamientos después.
safety.quote: The typhoon season in Taiwan normally runs from May to November. There’s a risk of road blockages and landslides after typhoons

safety.en: Earthquakes are a risk in Taiwan.
safety.es: Los terremotos son un riesgo en Taiwán.
safety.quote: Earthquakes are a risk in Taiwan.

safety.en: Scooters and motorcycles often weave through traffic, and vehicles might not stop at pedestrian crossings.
safety.es: Las scooters y motos suelen zigzaguear entre el tráfico y los vehículos podrían no detenerse en los pasos de peatones.
safety.quote: scooters and motorcycles often weave in and out of traffic. Be alert when crossing roads as vehicles might not stop at pedestrian crossings.

health.en: Call 119 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Llama al 119 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 119 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: There has been a significant increase in dengue fever cases in the south of Taiwan, including Kaohsiung and Tainan.
health.es: Ha habido un aumento significativo de casos de dengue en el sur de Taiwán, incluidas Kaohsiung y Tainan.
health.quote: There has been a significant increase in cases of dengue fever in the south of Taiwan (including the cities of Kaohsiung and Tainan).

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Taiwan.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Taiwán.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Taiwan.

health.en: Prescribed medicine brought into Taiwan needs a prescription showing it is for personal use.
health.es: Los medicamentos recetados que se traigan a Taiwán requieren una receta que indique que son de uso personal.
health.quote: bring the prescription issued by your doctor, hospital or clinic that shows the medicine is for your personal use.

health.en: Hospitals operate on a pay-as-you-use basis, so adequate travel health insurance is needed.
health.es: Los hospitales funcionan con pago por uso, por lo que se necesita un seguro médico de viaje adecuado.
health.quote: Hospitals operate on a ’pay as you use’ basis.

health.en: The text says tap water is generally safe to drink according to the water company, but most locals boil it first.
health.es: El texto dice que el agua del grifo es en general segura según la compañía de aguas, pero la mayoría de los locales la hierve antes.
health.quote: tap water is in general safe to drink. However, most locals prefer to boil the tap water before drinking

help.en: Ambulance and fire are reached on 119, and police on 110.
help.es: Ambulancia y bomberos se contactan en el 119, y la policía en el 110.
El número de la guardia costera es el 118.

help.en: The 'Information for Foreigners in Taiwan' helpline is 0800 024 111.
help.es: La línea 'Información para extranjeros en Taiwán' es el 0800 024 111.
help.quote: Any further assistance: 0800 024 111 (‘Information for Foreigners in Taiwan’ helpline)

help.en: The domestic abuse and sexual assault hotline is 113.
help.es: La línea de violencia doméstica y agresión sexual es el 113.
help.quote: Domestic abuse and sexual assault hotline: 113

getting_in.en: Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) is the primary international airport, located 40 km west of Taipei.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Taiwán Taoyuan (TPE) es el principal aeropuerto internacional, situado a 40 km al oeste de Taipéi.
getting_in.quote: is the primary international airport of Taiwan. Located 40 km west of Taipei

getting_in.en: Songshan Airport in downtown Taipei serves mostly domestic flights with some flights to mainland China, Tokyo Haneda and Seoul Gimpo.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Songshan, en el centro de Taipéi, atiende sobre todo vuelos nacionales y algunos a China continental, Tokio Haneda y Seúl Gimpo.
getting_in.quote: is a smaller airport in downtown Taipei which serves mostly domestic flights with some flights to mainland China, Tokyo Haneda Airport, and Seoul Gimpo Airport.

getting_in.en: The text says no visa is needed for connecting between international flights if you do not leave the airport's secure area.
getting_in.es: El texto indica que no se necesita visado para conectar entre vuelos internacionales si no se sale de la zona segura del aeropuerto.
getting_in.quote: No visa is required if you are connecting between international flights so long as you do not leave an airport's secure area.

getting_in.en: The text says all foreigners aged 14 and older are electronically fingerprinted and photographed on entry, with some exceptions.
getting_in.es: El texto indica que todos los extranjeros de 14 años o más son fotografiados y se les toman huellas digitales al entrar, con algunas excepciones.
getting_in.quote: All foreigners age 14 and older (except those on government business and certain permanent residents) are electronically fingerprinted and photographed as part of immigration entry procedures.

getting_around.en: The EasyCard and iPass smart cards replace separate tickets for most buses, metro and train services across Taiwan.
getting_around.es: Las tarjetas EasyCard e iPass sustituyen los billetes separados en la mayoría de autobuses, metros y trenes de Taiwán.
getting_around.quote: replace the need to buy separate tickets for most national, regional and city buses, metro (MRT), as well as train services (TRA) all over Taiwan

getting_around.en: The text says the EasyCard can be bought at the airport, in Taipei MRT stations and most convenience stores.
getting_around.es: El texto indica que la EasyCard se puede comprar en el aeropuerto, en las estaciones del MRT de Taipéi y en la mayoría de tiendas de conveniencia.
getting_around.quote: The EasyCard can be bought at the airport, in any of stations of Taipei MRT and most convenient stores.

getting_around.en: The Taiwan High Speed Rail runs between Taipei and Kaohsiung in as little as 95 minutes.
getting_around.es: El tren de alta velocidad de Taiwán conecta Taipéi y Kaohsiung en tan solo 95 minutos.
getting_around.quote: It runs between Taipei and Kaohsiung, taking as little as 95 minutes between the two cities.

getting_around.en: The text notes there is no rail line between Taichung and Hualien, so you must drive, fly or detour via Taipei or Kaohsiung.
getting_around.es: El texto señala que no hay línea de tren entre Taichung y Hualien, por lo que hay que conducir, volar o dar un rodeo por Taipéi o Kaohsiung.
getting_around.quote: there is no rail line from Taichung to Hualien, so you will have to either drive, fly, or take a major detour via Taipei or Kaohsiung.

getting_around.en: The text says buses are generally cheaper than trains, especially for long distances.
getting_around.es: El texto dice que los autobuses suelen ser más baratos que los trenes, sobre todo en largas distancias.
getting_around.quote: Traveling by bus is generally cheaper than by train, especially for long-distance trips.

getting_around.en: You need to hail the bus you want as it approaches, much like hailing a taxi.
getting_around.es: Hay que hacer señas al autobús que se quiere tomar cuando se acerca, como con un taxi.
getting_around.quote: In Taiwan you need to hail the bus you are taking as you see it coming—much like hailing a taxi.

money.en: The currency is the New Taiwan dollar (NT$, ISO code NTD, also referred to as TWD).
money.es: La moneda es el nuevo dólar taiwanés (NT$, código ISO NTD, también llamado TWD).
money.quote: The currency of Taiwan is the New Taiwan dollar, denoted by the symbol "NT$"

money.en: The text says travellers can take only up to NT$100,000, 20,000 RMB and US$10,000 in cash into or out of the island.
money.es: El texto indica que los viajeros solo pueden llevar hasta NT$100.000, 20.000 RMB y US$10.000 en efectivo al entrar o salir de la isla.
money.quote: travelers can only take cash up to a maximum of NT$100,000, 20,000 RMB, and (currencies calculated independently) US$10,000 into or out of the island.

money.en: The text says there is a per transaction limit of NT$20,000 for ATM cash withdrawals.
money.es: El texto indica que hay un límite de NT$20.000 por transacción en los retiros de cajeros.
money.quote: There is a per transaction limit of NT$20,000 for ATM cash withdrawals

money.en: Most ATMs in 7-11 stores accept international cards, while other ATMs may not.
money.es: La mayoría de cajeros de las tiendas 7-11 aceptan tarjetas internacionales; otros cajeros pueden no hacerlo.
money.quote: Most of the ATMs in 7-11 stores accept international cards. Other ATMs may accept them, but not all do.

money.en: Most hotels and department stores accept credit and debit cards, generally Visa, MasterCard and JCB.
money.es: La mayoría de hoteles y grandes almacenes aceptan tarjetas de crédito y débito, generalmente Visa, MasterCard y JCB.
money.quote: Most hotels and department stores accept credit and debit cards, generally Visa, MasterCard, and JCB.

money.en: The text says most prices are now fixed, whereas bargaining used to be expected in night markets and smaller stores.
money.es: El texto dice que ahora la mayoría de los precios son fijos, mientras que antes se esperaba regatear en mercados nocturnos y tiendas pequeñas.
money.quote: Whilst bargaining was OK in the past and expected in night markets as well as smaller stores, nowadays most prices are fixed.

etiquette.en: The text says business cards should be given and received with both hands and a slight bow of the head.
etiquette.es: El texto indica que las tarjetas de visita se deben dar y recibir con ambas manos y una ligera inclinación de cabeza.
etiquette.quote: When giving and receiving business cards, always do it using both hands and with a slight bow of the head.

etiquette.en: The text says you are expected to remove your shoes before entering a house.
etiquette.es: El texto indica que se espera que te quites los zapatos antes de entrar en una casa.
etiquette.quote: you are expected to remove your shoes before entering a house.

etiquette.en: The text says the number 4 sounds like the word for death in Mandarin, and some Taiwanese are superstitious about it.
etiquette.es: El texto indica que el número 4 suena como la palabra para muerte en mandarín, y algunos taiwaneses son supersticiosos al respecto.
etiquette.quote: The number 4 (four, pronounced 'si') sounds like the word for death in Mandarin.

etiquette.en: The text says not to write people's names in red, as it has connotations of death.
etiquette.es: El texto indica no escribir nombres de personas en rojo, por sus connotaciones de muerte.
etiquette.quote: Do not write people's names in red. This again has connotations of death.

etiquette.en: The text says clocks, shoes, knives and umbrellas should not be given as gifts.
etiquette.es: El texto indica que no se deben regalar relojes, zapatos, cuchillos ni paraguas.
etiquette.quote: There are numerous taboos dictating that certain objects shouldn't be given to others

etiquette.en: The text says bowing to greet people has fallen out of custom as handshakes and waves have become more common.
etiquette.es: El texto indica que inclinarse para saludar ha caído en desuso, ya que son más comunes los apretones de manos y los saludos con la mano.
etiquette.quote: bowing to greet people has fallen out of custom as handshakes and waves have become more common.

connectivity.en: iTaiwan is a free WiFi service in almost all public places, and no registration is needed.
connectivity.es: iTaiwan es un servicio WiFi gratuito disponible en casi todos los lugares públicos y no requiere registro.
connectivity.quote: You don't need to register to access iTaiwan.

connectivity.en: Prepaid 4G unlimited data SIM cards cost NT$300 for 3 days or NT$500 for 7 days at Chunghwa Telecom, Taiwan Mobile or Far EasTone.
connectivity.es: Las SIM 4G prepago con datos ilimitados cuestan NT$300 por 3 días o NT$500 por 7 días en Chunghwa Telecom, Taiwan Mobile o Far EasTone.
connectivity.quote: you can purchase a prepaid 4G unlimited data sim card from Chunghwa Telecom, Taiwan Mobile, or Far EasTone at a cost of NT$300 for 3 days, or NT$500 for 7 days

connectivity.en: A SIM purchase requires your passport and identification documents from your country of origin.
connectivity.es: Para comprar una SIM se necesita el pasaporte y documentos de identificación del país de origen.
connectivity.quote: They need your passport and identification documents of your country of origin, driving license or identification card.

connectivity.en: You can also buy an eSIM in advance, and may have to manually select the network and APN.
connectivity.es: También se puede comprar una eSIM por adelantado y puede que haya que elegir manualmente la red y el APN.
connectivity.quote: You can also buy an eSIM in advance from companies like Nomad or Airalo. You may have to manually select the network and APN.

connectivity.en: Mobile phone coverage is generally excellent, except in some remote mountainous areas.
connectivity.es: La cobertura móvil es generalmente excelente, salvo en algunas zonas montañosas remotas.
connectivity.quote: Mobile phone coverage is generally excellent in Taiwan, except in some remote mountainous areas.
